item.title: Swiss Study Says No Helmet Protects Your Head When Skiing or Snowboarding at Real Speed
item.description: A Swiss study recently released says that no helmet on Earth can protect skiers and snowboarders when they are riding at real speeds on the slopes.

item.title: Ben Gravy Surfs Massive Outer Reef During Hawaii’s XL Swell
item.description: Ben Gravy made a name for himself by surfing weird waves. But he really likes big waves, too, so he made sure to be there for Hawaii's XL swell.

item.title: We Spoke With Carlos Burle About His Nazaré Wipeout and the Danger of Handheld Cameras
item.description: Carlos Burle says his recent Nazaré wipeout was the worst hold-down he’s ever experienced. After being rescued, the Brazilian was taken to the hospital.

item.title: Koa Rothman and a Hyperbolic ‘Most Dangerous Day Surfing Pipeline’
item.description: If you are at Pipeline and you see Koa Rothman, Nate Florence, and Jamie O'Brien sitting in the sand instead of surfing, you might consider taking the hint.

item.title: Woman Pleads Guilty to Selling Fraudulently ‘Discounted’ Ikon and Epic Ski Passes
item.description: Deals on Ikon or Epic passes are too good to be true these days. One South Carolina woman was found guilty of fraud regarding Ikon and Epic pass sales.

item.title: Adriano de Souza Finds New Purpose a Decade After Championship Tour Glory
item.description: Adriano de Souza once stood on the podium as the new world champion. A decade later, he’s again a familiar face on the Tour — but on the other side of the rope.

item.title: Skier Parkin Costain Fell Through a 60-Foot Chimney in the Mountains and Lived to Tell the Tale
item.description: Parkin Costain is aware that skiing at the level he skis at can be dangerous, but in this case, he found himself falling through a 60-foot hole in a mountain.

item.title: MLK and Juneteenth Removed from National Parks’ ‘Fee Free’ Days, Trump’s Birthday Added
item.description: Criticism is still falling on the White House given its policies to scale back and pause federal initiatives related to the Civil Rights Movement and DEI.

item.title: WSL Issues Yellow Alert for Nazaré Challenge, Possible Green Light for Saturday
item.description: The announcement stated that contest officials will be tracking a swell set to peak overnight on Friday, with a possible green light for the event on Saturday.

item.title: Nic Von Rupp: This Weekend’s Nazaré Swell Could Be One of the Best in Years
item.description: Nic von Rupp says Nazaré is looking primed to show the best version of itself in years this weekend with wave faces up to 60 feet groomed by offshore winds.
